"},{"span_id":"8745:1@U002","start":106,"end":258,"text":"Doors that will allow them to obtain a job position with great salary and that will give them an opportunity to do what they are most passionate about. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U003","start":258,"end":403,"text":"Just like many of these individuals, my goal is to open myself to new opportunities and experiences in order to achieve my desired career field. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U004","start":403,"end":496,"text":"Internships are a great way to get hands-on experience of one's pursuing type of employment. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U005","start":496,"end":547,"text":"However, companies do not just pick any person;

"},{"span_id":"8745:1@U006","start":547,"end":664,"text":"they must choose interns that show promising characteristics and work ethic: someone who will stand out from others. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U007","start":664,"end":786,"text":"To be en engineer is my dream job, and I would appreciate it greatly if I were to be chosen as an intern in this company. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U008","start":786,"end":914,"text":"It would be to your greatest interest to have me as an intern because I show promising results and diversity in multiple ways.
"},{"span_id":"8745:1@U009","start":914,"end":962,"text":"
I am not a stranger to the engineering field. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U010","start":962,"end":1020,"text":"I have been exposed to a series of people in this career. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U011","start":1020,"end":1110,"text":"My father is one of the best engineers at his company, and he leads several big projects. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U012","start":1110,"end":1158,"text":"He is the person I aspire to become or surpass. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U013","start":1158,"end":1222,"text":"Still, my father is not my sole relative following this career. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U014","start":1222,"end":1397,"text":"Several of my uncles have pursued this job choice, and my aunt who, even though her current job is that of a nurse, is currently studying to obtain her degree in engineering. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U015","start":1397,"end":1539,"text":"Adding to this, I am also surrounded by non-relatives who have jobs as engineers, since I live in a city with multiple engineering companies. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U016","start":1539,"end":1685,"text":"This shows that I have been exposed to engineering in several ways, which has given me an insight of what to expect while studying for the role.
"},{"span_id":"8745:1@U017","start":1685,"end":1777,"text":"
It is no secret that engineering is one of the fields that require numerous math classes. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U018","start":1777,"end":1858,"text":"Many would see this as a negative aspect of becoming an engineer; yet, I do not. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U019","start":1858,"end":1926,"text":"Mathematics have been one of my passions since I was a little girl. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U020","start":1926,"end":2015,"text":"It would fascinate me how much critical thinking and solving-problem skills it required. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U021","start":2015,"end":2054,"text":"This, of course, has not changed much. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U022","start":2054,"end":2194,"text":"Although the classes are getting more difficult as the years pass, my passion for math has not ceased; instead, one could say it has grown. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U023","start":2194,"end":2375,"text":"I am not the type of person to give up on a math problem because it is "too hard." If I am faced with a challenge, I will use all of my available sources of aid to find the answer. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U024","start":2375,"end":2457,"text":"It is this kind of dedication and hard work that has led me to where I am today.
"},{"span_id":"8745:1@U025","start":2457,"end":2593,"text":"
Diversity stands out in applications, and many companies and organizations search for those individuals that stand out from the rest. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U026","start":2593,"end":2728,"text":"There are not many women that choose engineering as their first career choice, yet I, a woman, am studying and aiming for engineering. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U027","start":2728,"end":2824,"text":"I would be the the second woman in my family to aim for this position: the first being my aunt. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U028","start":2824,"end":2935,"text":"Nevertheless, although being a woman already stands out in the engineering field, there is more of me to show. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U029","start":2935,"end":2981,"text":"For example, I am a Latina from Generic_City. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U030","start":2981,"end":3071,"text":"I lived in Generic_City up to the age of eight, which has consequently made me bilingual. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U031","start":3071,"end":3180,"text":"However, I do not only speak Spanish and English; this upcoming year, I will finish my fifth year in French. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U032","start":3180,"end":3269,"text":"Knowing multiple languages breaks many language barriers and provide more opportunities. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U033","start":3269,"end":3343,"text":"Knowing this, I decided to take part in Spanish and French Honor Society. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U034","start":3343,"end":3428,"text":"Standing out from the rest is not only an individual's goal, but also a companies'.
"},{"span_id":"8745:1@U035","start":3428,"end":3470,"text":"
The path to success in not an easy one. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U036","start":3470,"end":3519,"text":"One must submit to hours of work and dedication. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U037","start":3519,"end":3600,"text":"In this year's internship, I would be fascinated to participate in your company. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U038","start":3600,"end":3703,"text":"Since it is many students' goal to open doors for the future, I am sure there is competition involved. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U039","start":3703,"end":3784,"text":"Despite of this, I show a variety of characteristics that many would appreciate. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U040","start":3784,"end":3849,"text":"My goal is to become a successful engineer, just like my father. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U041","start":3849,"end":3970,"text":"My father, other relatives, and friends have allowed me to experience an insight into what being an engineering is like. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U042","start":3970,"end":4091,"text":"One of the things I picked up on was that there is a lot of math involved in this career; still, this is not a downfall. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U043","start":4091,"end":4166,"text":"For many years, I have been fascinated by mathematics and problem-solving. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U044","start":4166,"end":4299,"text":"The fact that math is required to be an engineer is not a complication; instead, it is an opportunity to study further what I enjoy. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U045","start":4299,"end":4426,"text":"Not only am I passionate about becoming an engineering, I also show diversity; which will make me, and the company, stand out. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U046","start":4426,"end":4528,"text":"I am the minority of female Mexican engineers, and I break the language barrier with three languages. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U047","start":4528,"end":4631,"text":"I am one out of many applicants in this internship; however, I am passionate, hardworking, and unique. "},{"span_id":"8745:1@U048","start":4631,"end":4650,"text":"I am one of a kind."}],"traits":{"Cohesion":4,"Syntax":5,"Vocabulary":5,"Phraseology":4,"Grammar":4,"Conventions":5}}],"official_rubric":{"5":{"Overall":"Native-like facility in the use of language with syntactic variety, Appropriate word choice and phrases; they must choose interns that show promising characteristics and work ethic: someone who will stand out from others. To be en engineer is my dream job, and I would appreciate it greatly if I were to be chosen as an intern in this company. It would be to your greatest interest to have me as an intern because I show promising results and diversity in multiple ways.

I am not a stranger to the engineering field. I have been exposed to a series of people in this career. My father is one of the best engineers at his company, and he leads several big projects. He is the person I aspire to become or surpass. Still, my father is not my sole relative following this career. Several of my uncles have pursued this job choice, and my aunt who, even though her current job is that of a nurse, is currently studying to obtain her degree in engineering. Adding to this, I am also surrounded by non-relatives who have jobs as engineers, since I live in a city with multiple engineering companies. This shows that I have been exposed to engineering in several ways, which has given me an insight of what to expect while studying for the role.

It is no secret that engineering is one of the fields that require numerous math classes. Many would see this as a negative aspect of becoming an engineer; yet, I do not. Mathematics have been one of my passions since I was a little girl. It would fascinate me how much critical thinking and solving-problem skills it required. This, of course, has not changed much. Although the classes are getting more difficult as the years pass, my passion for math has not ceased; instead, one could say it has grown. I am not the type of person to give up on a math problem because it is "too hard." If I am faced with a challenge, I will use all of my available sources of aid to find the answer. It is this kind of dedication and hard work that has led me to where I am today.

Diversity stands out in applications, and many companies and organizations search for those individuals that stand out from the rest. I would be the the second woman in my family to aim for this position: the first being my aunt. Nevertheless, although being a woman already stands out in the engineering field, there is more of me to show. For example, I am a Latina from Generic_City. Knowing multiple languages breaks many language barriers and provide more opportunities. Knowing this, I decided to take part in Spanish and French Honor Society. Standing out from the rest is not only an individual's goal, but also a companies'.

The path to success in not an easy one. One must submit to hours of work and dedication. In this year's internship, I would be fascinated to participate in your company. Not only am I passionate about becoming an engineering, I also show diversity; which will make me, and the company, stand out. Just like many of these individuals, my goal is to open myself to new opportunities and experiences in order to achieve my desired career field. Internships are a great way to get hands-on experience of one's pursuing type of employment. However, companies do not just pick any person;

they must choose interns that show promising characteristics and work ethic: someone who will stand out from others. To be en engineer is my dream job, and I would appreciate it greatly if I were to be chosen as an intern in this company. It would be to your greatest interest to have me as an intern because I show promising results and diversity in multiple ways.

I am not a stranger to the engineering field. I have been exposed to a series of people in this career. My father is one of the best engineers at his company, and he leads several big projects. He is the person I aspire to become or surpass. Still, my father is not my sole relative following this career. Several of my uncles have pursued this job choice, and my aunt who, even though her current job is that of a nurse, is currently studying to obtain her degree in engineering. Adding to this, I am also surrounded by non-relatives who have jobs as engineers, since I live in a city with multiple engineering companies. This shows that I have been exposed to engineering in several ways, which has given me an insight of what to expect while studying for the role.

It is no secret that engineering is one of the fields that require numerous math classes. Many would see this as a negative aspect of becoming an engineer; yet, I do not. Mathematics have been one of my passions since I was a little girl. It would fascinate me how much critical thinking and solving-problem skills it required. This, of course, has not changed much. Although the classes are getting more difficult as the years pass, my passion for math has not ceased; instead, one could say it has grown. I am not the type of person to give up on a math problem because it is "too hard." If I am faced with a challenge, I will use all of my available sources of aid to find the answer. It is this kind of dedication and hard work that has led me to where I am today.

Diversity stands out in applications, and many companies and organizations search for those individuals that stand out from the rest. There are not many women that choose engineering as their first career choice, yet I, a woman, am studying and aiming for engineering. I would be the the second woman in my family to aim for this position: the first being my aunt. Nevertheless, although being a woman already stands out in the engineering field, there is more of me to show. For example, I am a Latina from Generic_City. I lived in Generic_City up to the age of eight, which has consequently made me bilingual. However, I do not only speak Spanish and English; this upcoming year, I will finish my fifth year in French. Knowing multiple languages breaks many language barriers and provide more opportunities. Knowing this, I decided to take part in Spanish and French Honor Society. Standing out from the rest is not only an individual's goal, but also a companies'.

The path to success in not an easy one. One must submit to hours of work and dedication. In this year's internship, I would be fascinated to participate in your company. Several of my uncles have pursued this job choice, and my aunt who, even though her current job is that of a nurse, is currently studying to obtain her degree in engineering. "},{"span_id":"1462:1@U005","start":367,"end":444,"text":"That is why I desagree that they should start an afterschool homework club.

"},{"span_id":"8722:1@U002","start":19,"end":120,"text":"If our school were to change the cafeteria food to healthier food selections it would be a bad idea. "},{"span_id":"8722:1@U003","start":120,"end":314,"text":"This decision would be a bad idea because some students do not eat lunch as it is, other students say that the cafeteria food is already healthy, others would leave campus or order food online. "},{"span_id":"8722:1@U004","start":314,"end":449,"text":"Some schools in other school districts have changed their school menu and many students and parents do not like it nor agree with it.
"},{"span_id":"8722:1@U005","start":449,"end":523,"text":"
Students do not eat lunch now a days because they do not like the food. "},{"span_id":"8722:1@U006","start":523,"end":672,"text":"Some rather just go to the snack bar or vending machine we have in the cafeteria and eat snacks rather than food or bring their own lunch to school. "},{"span_id":"8722:1@U007","start":672,"end":824,"text":"Students bring their own food most of the time because they are used to different foods or they are allergic to certain types of foods or ingredients.
"},{"span_id":"8722:1@U008","start":824,"end":885,"text":"
Others may say that the cafeteria food is already healthy. "},{"span_id":"8722:1@U009","start":885,"end":954,"text":"In the cafeteria there are many options in the four different lines. "},{"span_id":"8722:1@U010","start":954,"end":1055,"text":"For example one line can have three main foods with different sides including fruits and vegetables. "},{"span_id":"8722:1@U011","start":1055,"end":1156,"text":"The school line also has an option between the three main foods they are serving or a salad or wrap. "},{"span_id":"8722:1@U012","start":1156,"end":1288,"text":"When the school cafeteria serves bread or any type of carbs it usually is always wheat bread which is better than any other bread.
"},{"span_id":"8722:1@U013","start":1288,"end":1387,"text":"
Students who have cars or credit cards often leave school to get food or they order food online. "},{"span_id":"8722:1@U014","start":1387,"end":1567,"text":"Upperclassmen, juniors and seniors are often the ones who leave campus to get food because they have there license and have cars or they also have friends who have transportation. "},{"span_id":"8722:1@U015","start":1567,"end":1682,"text":"They usually do not come back for their last periods of the day or if they come back they come back late to class. "},{"span_id":"8722:1@U016","start":1682,"end":1786,"text":"Now with new technology and apps students order food through apps that deliver any type of food to you. "},{"span_id":"8722:1@U017","start":1786,"end":1864,"text":"Students often get in trouble by teachers and staff for it but do it anyway.
"},{"span_id":"8722:1@U018","start":1864,"end":1996,"text":"
In conclusion these are some of the reasons why changing the school cafeteria lunch/menu to a healthier menu would be a bad idea. "},{"span_id":"8722:1@U019","start":1996,"end":2121,"text":"Students who do not like the school lunches already do not eat, they would leave campus and not come back or come back late. "},{"span_id":"8722:1@U020","start":2121,"end":2247,"text":"And if they change the school menu there would be more students willing to do the same thing. When the school cafeteria serves bread or any type of carbs it usually is always wheat bread which is better than any other bread.

Students who have cars or credit cards often leave school to get food or they order food online. Upperclassmen, juniors and seniors are often the ones who leave campus to get food because they have there license and have cars or they also have friends who have transportation. Now with new technology and apps students order food through apps that deliver any type of food to you. Students often get in trouble by teachers and staff for it but do it anyway.

In conclusion these are some of the reasons why changing the school cafeteria lunch/menu to a healthier menu would be a bad idea. If our school were to change the cafeteria food to healthier food selections it would be a bad idea. Some schools in other school districts have changed their school menu and many students and parents do not like it nor agree with it.

Students do not eat lunch now a days because they do not like the food. Some rather just go to the snack bar or vending machine we have in the cafeteria and eat snacks rather than food or bring their own lunch to school. Students bring their own food most of the time because they are used to different foods or they are allergic to certain types of foods or ingredients.

Others may say that the cafeteria food is already healthy. In the cafeteria there are many options in the four different lines. For example one line can have three main foods with different sides including fruits and vegetables. The school line also has an option between the three main foods they are serving or a salad or wrap. When the school cafeteria serves bread or any type of carbs it usually is always wheat bread which is better than any other bread.

Students who have cars or credit cards often leave school to get food or they order food online. Upperclassmen, juniors and seniors are often the ones who leave campus to get food because they have there license and have cars or they also have friends who have transportation. They usually do not come back for their last periods of the day or if they come back they come back late to class. Now with new technology and apps students order food through apps that deliver any type of food to you. Students often get in trouble by teachers and staff for it but do it anyway.

In conclusion these are some of the reasons why changing the school cafeteria lunch/menu to a healthier menu would be a bad idea. Students who do not like the school lunches already do not eat, they would leave campus and not come back or come back late. And if they change the school menu there would be more students willing to do the same thing.
